papers.title: [ZHUANG Lixing's clinical experience for sudden hearing loss with the "regulating the spirit and restoring the pivot" acupuncture method].
papers.journal: Zhongguo zhen jiu = Chinese acupuncture & moxibustion
papers.authors: Han M, Liao K, Zhan J, Zeng Y, Zhuang L
papers.abstract: This article summarizes Professor ZHUANG Lixing 's clinical experience for sudden hearing loss with the "regulating the spirit and restoring the pivot" acupuncture method. Professor ZHUANG considers that the disease is mostly caused by emotional disturbance and dysfunction of the Shaoyang pivot, and advocates early acupuncture and moxibustion intervention. The pathogenesis of "closure of the orifices and concealment of the spirit as the manifestation, and impaired pivot mechanism as the root" should be closely followed, and the therapeutic principle of "regulating the spirit as the priority and restoring the pivot as the key" should be applied. In clinical practice, acupoints on the governor vessel, such as Shenting (GV24) and Yintang (GV24+), are selected to regulate the spirit, while acupoints on the Shaoyang meridians, such as Tinghui (GB2) and Yifeng (TE17), are selected to restore the pivot, supplemented by flexible selection of additional acupoints according to the presenting pattern. Together, these methods open the orifices and relieve obstruction, unblock the ear, and restore hearing.

papers.title: [YANG Jun's clinical experience in treating rotational spasmodic torticollis through differentiation on pathogenesis, sinews/fascia of meridians and muscles].
papers.journal: Zhongguo zhen jiu = Chinese acupuncture & moxibustion
papers.authors: Zhang J, Xiao H, Zhang Q, Cui J, Huang Z, Zhang L et al.
papers.abstract: The paper introduces Professor YANG Jun 's clinical experience in diagnosis and treatment of rotational spasmodic torticollis with acupuncture and moxibustion. Professor YANG believes that this disorder is rooted in yang deficiency, manifesting clinically as disturbances caused by internal and external wind pathogens. The crucial factor lies on the impaired distribution of the governor vessel, and the location of disorder is on sinews/fascia of meridians. Under the general principle of "yang deficiency with wind agitation", it is essential to precisely differentiate three syndromes/patterns, including cold-dampness obstructing the collaterals, yin deficiency stirring up wind, and phlegm-stasis obstructing the collaterals. The treatment approach focuses on regulating yang and unblocking the governor vessel, as well as relaxing tendons and relieving spasms; and it emphasizes a layered therapeutic strategy based on three distinct levels, i.e., identifying the underlying pathogenic mechanism, assessing the affected sinews/fascia of meridians, and determining the targeted muscle groups. Differentiating pathogenesis is to distinguish the deficiency of root causes from the excess of clinical symptoms, differentiating sinews/fascia of meridians is to determine the location of illness, and differentiating muscles serves to identify the affected muscle groups. In treatment, the local acupoints are selected precisely and combined with the distal ones based on meridian distribution, the appropriate acupoints are used in accordance with the specific syndromes/patterns, the acupoints of the governor vessel are especially combined with scalp acupuncture. In operation, transverse needling, point-toward-point needling, surrounding needling and bone-targeting needle techniques are employed. All the aforementioned provide the references for clinical diagnosis and treatment of rotational spasmodic torticollis.

papers.title: [WANG Jihong's experience in treatment of thyroid nodules with Tongyuan acupuncture therapy and "five acupoints from tianyou"].
papers.journal: Zhongguo zhen jiu = Chinese acupuncture & moxibustion
papers.authors: Huang S, Li Z, Huang Z, Li H, Wang J, Hou J
papers.abstract: This paper introduces Professor WANG Jihong's clinical experience in treatment of thyroid nodules with Tongyuan acupuncture therapy and "five acupoints from tianyou". Based on the theoretical framework of "mind/spirit, qi, the origin and body", as well as the holistic idea of TCM such as "nourishing mind/spirit" and "guiding qi ", thyroid nodules are treated in stages. In the early stage, the acupoints for unblocking the governor vessel and nourishing mind/spirit are selected, including Baihui (GV20), Yintang (CV24+), Dazhui (GV14), and Zhiyang (GV9). In the later stage, the acupoints for guiding qi back to the origin are selected, such as Guanyuan (CV4), Qihai (CV6), Danzhong (CV17), and Tianshu (ST25). Throughout the entire course of treatment, Renying (ST9) and Futu (LI18), two of the key points from "five acupoints from tianyou" documented in the Huangdi Neijing (Yellow Emperor 's Inner Classic) are incorporated to regulate qi movement and resolve tangible pathogenic accumulations in the neck region. This distinctive therapeutic approach embodies the principles of "addressing both symptoms and root cause simultaneously" and "mutual regulation of body and qi " in treatment. It not only alleviates the symptoms of thyroid nodules but also restores the dynamic equilibrium of "mind/spirit, qi, the origin and body", so as to reduce local lesion size, and the risk of malignant transformation, thereby obtaining the specific therapeutic effect of TCM, "prevention before disease onset, and prevention of progression after onset".

papers.title: [Acupuncture for facial laxity and sagging based on SHI Xuemin's meridian sinew acupuncture method].
papers.journal: Zhongguo zhen jiu = Chinese acupuncture & moxibustion
papers.authors: Li M, Peng T, Guo Y
papers.abstract: Based on Academician SHI Xuemin's meridian sinew acupuncture method, this article proposes the "four facial lifting methods" for the treatment of facial laxity and sagging, using facial acupuncture, stuck needle manipulation, acupotomy, and filiform needle acupuncture. Facial acupuncture, stuck needle manipulation, and acupotomy stimulate the meridian sinews to improve the "longitudinal sinews" of the hand and foot yang meridians in the facial and cervical regions. Filiform needle acupuncture with reinforcing methods could regulate qi and blood, promoting the upward nourishment of qi and blood to face. By utilizing the advantages of different acupuncture techniques to stimulate the meridian sinew system, this method treats both the root and the manifestations, achieving facial lifting effects and promoting facial rejuvenation, and provides a new approach for acupuncture cosmetology.

papers.title: [Effects of electroacupuncture on epididymal function and sperm quality in obese rats based on mitochondrial apoptosis pathway].
papers.journal: Zhongguo zhen jiu = Chinese acupuncture & moxibustion
papers.authors: Zhang J, Xiao Y, Li G, Yuan R, Huang X, Shen Y et al.
papers.abstract:
To observe the effect of electroacupuncture (EA) on epididymal function and sperm quality in obese rats, and explore the molecular mechanisms underlying EA-mediated improvement in obesity-related reproductive dysfunction.
Of 40 male Wistar rats, 8 rats were randomized as a blank group, and the rest rats were fed with high-fat diet for 8 weeks to establish obesity models. Twenty-four successfully modeled rats were randomly allocated into amodel group (n=8), an EA group (n=8), and a dietary adjustment group (n=8). The rats in the EA group received EA at "Zusanli" (ST36) and "Sanyinjiao" (SP6) using dense-disperse waves at 2 Hz/15 Hz frequency and 1.5 mA intensity for 30 min per session, 5 sessions per week, for 4 consecutive weeks. In the dietary adjustment group, the rats were fed regularly for 4 weeks. After intervention completion, body weight, body mass index (BMI), and Lee's index were recorded. HE staining was used to examine the morphology and mass of epididymal tissue and epididymal white adipose tissue (eWAT). Enzymatic colorimetric assay was employed to detect the levels of triglycerides (TG), total cholesterol (TC), low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C), and high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (HDL-C) in serum. Computer-aided sperm analysis system was used to assess sperm motility and sperm concentration in rats, the sperm chromatin dispersion assay was used to determine the sperm DNA fragmentation index (DFI), the dual-fluorescence staining combined with flow cytometry was used to assess the level of sperm apoptosis in the epididymis, the enzyme-linked spectrophotometry was used to quantitatively measure adenosine triphosphate (ATP) content in the epididymis, JC-1 fluorescence probe staining combined with flow cytometry was used to determine the mitochondrial membrane potential level in the epididymal cells; and Western blot was used to detect the protein expression levels of B-cell lymphoma-2 gene (BCL-2), BCL-2-associated X protein (BAX), Cytochrome c, cleaved cysteine-aspartate protease (Caspase)-3 and cleaved-Caspase-9 in the epididymis; the real-time quantitative PCR was used to detect the mRNA expression levels of BCL-2, BAX, Cytochrome c, Caspase-3 and Caspase-9 in the epididymis.
Compared with the blank group, the model group showed the increased body weight, BMI, and Lee's index (P<0.01), reduced relative epididymal mass (P<0.01); increased eWAT mass, relative eWAT mass, and mean eWAT adipocyte area (P<0.01); elevated serum TG, TC, and LDL-C levels (P<0.01), and decreased serum HDL-C level (P<0.01); disrupted epididymal tissue structure, reduced sperm concentration and motility (P<0.01), increased sperm DFI (P<0.01), and elevated sperm apoptosis rate (P<0.01); decreased epididymal mitochondrial membrane potential and ATP content (P<0.01); reduced protein and mRNA expression of BCL-2 (P<0.01), and increased protein expression of BAX, Cytochrome c, cleaved-Caspase-3 and cleaved-Caspase-9 (P<0.01), and the mRNA expression of BAX, Cytochrome c, Caspase-3 and Caspase-9. Compared with the model group, except for average adipocyte area, sperm concentration, sperm apoptosis rate, mitochondrial membrane potential, and BCL-2 protein expression, all other parameters in the EA group and the dietary adjustment group showed the improvements (P<0.01, P<0.05). Compared with the dietary adjustment group, the EA group exhibited the reduced body weight, average adipocyte area, serum TG, TC, and LDL-C levels, the protein and mRNA expression of Cytochrome c, as well as decreased mRNA expression of Caspase-3 and Caspase-9 (P<0.01, P<0.05); and the increases of the relative epididymal mass, sperm concentration and motility, serum HDL-C level, ATP content, and BCL-2 protein expression (P<0.01, P<0.05).
Electroacupuncture can effectively improve epididymal function and sperm quality in obese male rats, and the underlying mechanism may be associated with inhibiting the activation of the mitochondrial apoptosis pathway and maintaining mitochondrial functional homeostasis.

papers.title: [Mechanism research of Tongdu Tiaoshen acupuncture on post-stroke depression from the perspective of hippocampal neuron ferroptosis].
papers.journal: Zhongguo zhen jiu = Chinese acupuncture & moxibustion
papers.authors: Zou L, Zhang D, Yang S, Gao Z, Teng Z, Sun M et al.
papers.abstract:
To observe the effect of Tongdu Tiaoshen (unblocking the governor vessel and regulating the mind) acupuncture on post-stroke depression (PSD) from the perspective of hippocampal neuron ferroptosis, so as to explore the mechanism of this therapy on PSD.
Twenty-seven male SD rats were randomly divided into a sham-operation group (n=9) and a modeling group (n=18). PSD models were established by right unilateral common carotid artery occlusion combined with chronic unpredictable mild stress (CUMS) in the modeling group. The successfully modeled rats were randomly assigned to a model group (n=9) and a Tongdu Tiaoshen acupuncture group (n=9). In the Tongdu Tiaoshen group, Tongdu Tiaoshen acupuncture was delivered at "Baihui" (GV20), "Shenting" (GV24), "Shuigou" (GV26) and "Dazhui" (GV14), once daily, 6 interventions per week, with one day of rest, for a continuous intervention period of 4 weeks. The depression-like behaviors and neurofunctional impairment were assessed using open-field test, sucrose preference test, and the Zea Longa neurobehavioral score in rats. HE and Nissl staining were employed to observe neuronal morphology in the hippocampal dentate gyrus (DG region) of rats. ELISA was adopted to determine the levels of hippocampal iron ion, glutathione (GSH), malondialdehyde (MDA), and reactive oxygen species (ROS) in rats; and Western blot and real-time quantitative PCR were used to detect the protein and mRNA expression of hippocampal glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4), acyl-CoA synthetase long-chain family member 4 (ACSL4), transferrin receptor 1 (TFR1), solute carrier family 7 member 11 (SLC7A11) in rats separately.
Compared with the sham-operation group, in the model group, the moving distance and stay time in the central area of the open-field test, as well as sucrose preference rate were reduced (P<0.05), and the Zea Longa neurobehavioral score increased (P<0.05); the morphology of neurons in the hippocampal DG region was abnormal, the matrix was relatively loose, and the number of neuronal death increased (P<0.05); the levels of iron ion, MDA and ROS rose (P<0.05), and the level of GSH was reduced (P<0.05); the protein and mRNA expression of GPX4 and SLC7A11 in hippocampus decreased (P<0.05), and that of ACSL4 and TFR1 increased (P<0.05). When compared with the model group, in the Tongdu Tiaoshen acupuncture group, the moving distance and stay time in the central area of the open-field test, as well as sucrose preference rate increased (P<0.05), and the Zea Longa neurobehavioral score was reduced (P<0.05); the morphology of neurons in hippocampal DG region was improved obviously, the matrix was relatively dense, and the number of neuronal death was declined (P<0.05); the levels of iron ion, MDA and ROS in hippocampus were reduced (P<0.05), and the content of GSH was elevated (P<0.05); the protein and mRNA expression of GPX4 and SLC7A11 in hippocampus increased (P<0.05), and that of ACSL4 and TFR1 decreased (P<0.05).
Tongdu Tiaoshen acupuncture can alleviate depression-like behaviors in PSD modeled rats, and its mechanism is related to the inhibition of ferroptosis in hippocampal neurons.

papers.title: [Analysis of constructing an evidence ecological approach for acupoint selection in acupuncture and moxibustion based on multi-source evidence].
papers.journal: Zhongguo zhen jiu = Chinese acupuncture & moxibustion
papers.authors: Niu Q, Wang X, Yu C
papers.abstract: Addressing the evidence selection dilemma in acupoint selection in clinical practice of acupuncture and moxibustion, as well as the conflict between standardization and individualization, this study innovatively proposes the establishment of an evidence-based ecological approach to acupoint selection schemes grounded in multi-source evidence. By introducing the evidence challenges encountered in clinical acupuncture-moxibustion practice and the need for innovation in research paradigm, the paper systematically analyzes the connotation, characteristics and similarities/differences of multi-source evidence. It elaborates on the methodology for constructing the evidence ecological approach, comprising four steps, i.e., evidence mining and visual mapping, mechanism interpretation and logical integration, protocol generation and consensus decision-making, and dynamic validation and iterative optimization. Besides, a case study on knee osteoarthritis treatment is provided to demonstrate the approach. This study aims to establish a "core-module" based acupoint selection methodological pathway that integrates traditional classical text knowledge, expert experience, randomized controlled trial, data mining, and guidelines/expert consensus. By employing a dynamic validation for iterative optimization, this approach provides clinicians with a decision-support tool that combines standardized foundations with personalized flexibility, thereby driving the evolution of clinical practice of acupuncture and moxibustion toward a data-driven, evidence-integrated paradigm.

papers.journal: Gan to kagaku ryoho. Cancer & chemotherapy

papers.abstract: This study aimed to clarify the effects of acupuncture and hand therapy on physical and mental relaxation and immune function, by measuring changes in autonomic nervous system activity and salivary oxytocin and cortisol concentrations before and after acupuncture treatment. These physiological changes indicate that the treatments have a relaxing effect and may contribute to enhancing natural immune function. These results are significant from the perspective of maintaining a state of "pre-disease."

papers.title: Immediate Analgesic Effect of Acupuncture for Primary Dysmenorrhea: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
papers.authors: Zhang P, Li M, Lv J
papers.abstract:
This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the immediate analgesic effect of acupuncture for primary dysmenorrhea (PD), characterize its time-effect profile, and identify core influencing factors.
We systematically searched PubMed, the Cochrane Library, Web of Science, CNKI, Wanfang, and VIP databases from January 2006 to April 2026 for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) investigating acupuncture for PD. Two reviewers independently performed study screening, data extraction, and risk of bias assessment (RoB 2.0). Meta-analyses used RevMan 5.4.1; evidence certainty was rated with GRADE.
Thirty-six RCTs with 3,532 PD patients were included. Compared with blank control, single-point acupuncture produced analgesia from 5 minutes post-insertion, peaked at 30 minutes (MD = -30.86, 95% CI: -39.91 to -21.81, P < 0.00001), and persisted to 120 minutes post-withdrawal. Single-point acupuncture outperformed non-acupoint shallow needling (MD = -9.96, 95% CI: -19.16 to -0.75, P = 0.03),Sanyinjiao (SP6) exhibited a more prominent analgesic effect trend compared with Xuanzhong (GB39). Multi-acupoint combination was superior to single-point acupuncture (MD = -3.70, 95% CI: -5.82 to -1.57, P = 0.0007), stronger Deqi outperformed weaker Deqi (MD = -7.54, 95% CI: -10.05 to -5.02, P < 0.00001). At 30 minutes, acupuncture had greater analgesic effect than conventional medication (SMD = -2.97, 95% CI: -4.45 to -1.49, P < 0.0001); however, this comparison had very high heterogeneity (I2 = 96%) and very low GRADE certainty, and trim-and-fill correction suggested possible overestimation due to publication bias.
Acupuncture provides rapid-onset immediate analgesia for PD, with acupoint specificity, multi-acupoint combination, and Deqi intensity as key effect modifiers. Given the very low to moderate certainty of evidence and high heterogeneity, these findings are preliminary and require confirmation through large-sample, standardized, multicenter RCTs.

papers.title: Gut-derived signals in type 2 diabetes-associated dry eye: current evidence, causal uncertainty, and validation priorities.
papers.authors: Wei Q, Ding N, Fan S, Liang S, Gan L, Wu Y
papers.abstract: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM)-associated dry eye disease (DED) includes aqueous, evaporative, epithelial, inflammatory, and neurosensory phenotypes. Intestinal dysbiosis may contribute to some of these abnormalities, but the clinical and mechanistic evidence has not yet been synthesised in terms of disease relevance and causal strength. We conducted a structured narrative review using iterative PubMed searches, full-text retrieval from PubMed Central and publisher websites, and backward citation tracing. The evidence pool was updated to 26 July 2026. Human studies in T2DM consistently report neuropathy, corneal sensory or nerve changes, meibomian dysfunction, and lacrimal injury, but no human study jointly measuring intestinal microbiota or gut-derived metabolites with T2DM-DED outcomes was found. One disease-matched animal study linked a probiotic-prebiotic intervention with changes in intestinal, lacrimal, inflammatory, and dry-eye-like features. Other experimental models support microbiota-sensitive lacrimal responses, macrophage-dependent corneal nerve repair, and short-chain fatty acid (SCFA)-responsive ocular-surface homeostasis. Taken together, these findings establish model-specific effects rather than a continuous human pathway. SCFAs are therefore considered a hypothesis-prioritised candidate based on cross-model breadth, although their necessity, sufficiency, and mediation in T2DM-DED remain unknown. Diet, glycaemic control, obesity, renal function, neuropathy, medicines, and ocular treatment are important clinical confounders. Future studies should combine longitudinal human co-phenotyping with a disease-matched mediation experiment that measures intestinal, metabolic, lacrimal, corneal-neural, and ocular-surface outcomes in the same temporal sequence. Oral Chinese herbal medicine is presented only as one standardisable perturbation for such testing, rather than as an established gut-mediated therapy.

papers.title: Acupuncture before and during letrozole ovulation induction in women with overweight or obesity and PCOS-related infertility: a randomized sham-controlled pilot trial.
papers.authors: Dou Z, Zhang Y, Hao J, Zhao X, Zhu H, Gong Z et al.
papers.abstract:
Obesity-related metabolic dysfunction may impair fertility outcomes in women with overweight or obesity and polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS). We evaluated acupuncture initiated 3 months before letrozole ovulation induction and continued during treatment.
In this single-center, randomized, participant-blinded, sham-controlled pilot trial, 60 women aged 20-35 years with a body mass index ≥25 kg/m² were assigned 1:1 to acupuncture or nonpenetrating sham acupuncture. Both groups received lifestyle guidance. Interventions were administered during the 3-month pretreatment phase and up to three letrozole cycles. The primary outcomes were continuing pregnancy and live birth. Secondary outcomes included other reproductive, anthropometric, metabolic, endometrial, and uterine artery Doppler outcomes.
A total of 60 women were randomized, 55 completed follow-up and were included in the per-protocol analysis, while all 60 were included in the intention-to-treat analyses of pregnancy outcomes. In the per-protocol analysis, the live-birth rate was significantly higher in the acupuncture group than in the sham acupuncture group (14/27 [51.9%] vs. 6/28 [21.4%]; P = 0.03). The continuing-pregnancy rates were 14/27 (51.9%) and 8/28 (28.6%), respectively (P = 0.10). The biochemical-pregnancy rate was also higher in the acupuncture group (17/27 [63.0%] vs. 9/28 [32.1%]; P = 0.03), whereas clinical pregnancy and pregnancy loss did not differ significantly between the groups. The intention-to-treat analyses showed similar effect directions, although the differences were not statistically significant for live birth (46.7% vs. 20.0%; P = 0.054) or continuing pregnancy (46.7% vs. 26.7%; P = 0.18). Cycle-level ovulation was summarized descriptively. Acupuncture was associated with greater improvements in body weight, glucose and lipid metabolism, insulin resistance, leptin, and adiponectin and with more favorable endometrial thickness and morphology and uterine artery Doppler indices (all P < 0.05). No serious adverse events occurred.
These preliminary findings suggest that continuous acupuncture spanning pretreatment and ovulation induction may be associated with a higher live-birth rate and improvements in metabolic and endometrial parameters. Given the exploratory nature and limited sample size of this pilot trial, confirmation in larger multicenter trials is required.

papers.title: Exploring the therapeutic role of Chinses herbal medicine in the recurrence rate of uterine fibroids after conservative surgery: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.authors: Liu Z, Liu Y, Li S, Zhang X, Qiang R, Jin F et al.
papers.abstract:
Since surgery can only remove lesions of a larger size visible to the naked eye, the recurrence rate of uterine fibroids after surgery is high. In recent years, numerous scholars have found that traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) treatment is effective in reducing the recurrence rate of postoperative fibroids, as well as improving the clinical treatment rate, regulating serum hormone levels, reducing plasma viscosity, and promoting the restoration of uterine volume following surgery. Several randomized controlled trials have been undertaken on the prevention and treatment of postoperative recurrence of uterine fibroids using patented Chinese medicines and self-proposed formulations, such as Guizhi Fuling Pill, Xiaozheng decoction, Xiangleng pill, Zhengjia decoction, Xiaoliu decoction, Guizhi Jiliu pill, Huoxue Huayu formula, Huoxue Xiaozheng decoction, Shugan Sanjie decoction, Gongliuxiao capsule, Hongjin Xiaojie concentrated pill, and Jiawei Guizhi Fuling decoction. However, no study has systematically evaluated Chinese herbal medicine (CHM) in reducing the recurrence rate of uterine fibroids after surgery.
This study aimed to conduct a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials of CHM for the prevention of postoperative recurrence of uterine fibroids, evaluating its efficacy and safety.
A comprehensive search was conducted on PubMed, Cochrane, Embase, Web of Science, China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI), VIP Information Database (VIP), WanFang Database, and China Biomedical Database (CBM) to identify randomized controlled clinical studies conducted up to March 2025 that examined the efficacy of CHM in treating patients with postoperative uterine fibroids. Two institutes were independently under-selected, and data were extracted and quality assessed using the Cochrane Risk of Bias 2.0 tool. Meta-analyses were performed using Review Manager software 5.4, and forest plots were generated. The quality of evidence was assessed using GRADEpro 3.2.2. This study was registered in PROSPERO (CRD420251000288).
16 trials were included in this study, and the postoperative recurrence rate after treatment was mainly analyzed. CHM treatment reduces postoperative recurrence rates in patients with uterine fibroids compared to the blank (6 trials, n = 588; OR (odds ratio) = 0.22; 95 % CI (95 % confidence intervals) = 0.14-0.34; I2 = 0 %, p < 0.00001), conventional western medicine (CWM) (1 trial, n = 80; OR = 0.30; 95 % CI = 0.09-0.93, p = 0.04), and combined CHM with CWM (9 trials, n = 959; OR = 0.29; 95 % CI = 0.19-0.46; I2 = 0 %, p < 0.00001). In addition, CHM is also effective in improving clinical efficiency, restoring serum sex hormone levels, lowering plasma viscosity, and reducing uterine volume. CHM is generally considered safe, with a low incidence of adverse reactions.
CHM is effective in avoiding recurrence of uterine fibroids after surgery, excelling in terms of overall effectiveness, restoring female hormone levels, improving hemorheological indices, and promoting uterine recovery and safety. However, these findings are preliminary and still need to be validated by higher-quality studies.

papers.title: Network pharmacology-based identification and experimental validation of active compounds from Qingda Granules against Ang II-induced hypertension.
papers.authors: Zhang L, Ali F, Wu M, Guo Z, Lin G, Zhang X et al.
papers.abstract:
Hypertension is a significant global health issue that raises the risk of cardiovascular diseases (CVDs). Qingda Granule (QDG) is a traditional Chinese medicine formula used to treat hypertension, but its active compounds and mechanisms of action remain poorly understood.
Network pharmacology identified potential active compounds and KEGG pathways. Four compounds-gastrodin, rhynchophylline, baicalin, and liensinine were selected. Hypertension was induced in mice via Angiotensin II (Ang II) infusion. QDG (1145 mg/kg/day) or each compound (10 mg/kg/day) was administered orally once daily. Outcomes measured included systolic blood pressure (SBP), diastolic blood pressure (DBP), mean arterial pressure (MAP), pulse wave velocity (PWV), and abdominal aortic wall thickness. Histological examination and immunohistochemistry for expression of total myosin light chain (MLC) and phosphorylation of myosin light chain (p-MLC) were performed in exploratory subgroups of three mice per group.
Network pharmacology analysis identified 482 predicted targets overlapping with hypertension-related targets. The compound-target network was constructed and analyzed, and hub nodes were identified using multiple parameters, such as betweenness centrality and degree. These four selected compounds-gastrodin, rhynchophylline, baicalin, and liensinine-ranked among the top 50 nodes in the compound-target network. Consequently, these four compounds were selected for further validation. KEGG enrichment analysis identified vascular smooth muscle contraction as an enriched candidate pathway (18 targets). In vivo, QDG and all four compounds treatment significantly lowered blood pressure, lowered PWV, and reduced abdominal aortic wall thickness. Exploratory subgroup analyses showed attenuated aortic histopathological changes and reduced p-MLC immunoreactivity, with no significant difference in total MLC immunoreactivity in abdominal aortic tissues of Ang II-infused mice.
QDG and its four individually administered compounds attenuated blood pressure elevation and were associated with lower PWV and reduced abdominal aortic wall thickening in Ang II-infused mice, as well as reduced p-MLC immunoreactivity. These findings suggest that the QDG and its four compounds contribute to antihypertensive effects.

papers.title: Response surface optimisation of Xiaoyao San polyphenols and anti-inflammatory activity in colonic epithelial cells.
papers.authors: Huang YX, Que ZQ, Cheng Y, Zheng FP, Chen XQ
papers.abstract: Xiaoyao San is a traditional Chinese medicine formula, but its polyphenol extraction and intestinal epithelial activity remain insufficiently defined. We optimised ethanol-reflux extraction by response surface methodology and evaluated the polyphenol-rich fraction in NCM460 cells. The validated optimum was 57% ethanol, a 7.6 mL/g liquid-solid ratio, and 94 min, yielding 7.44 ± 0.15 mg gallic acid equivalents per gram. Xiaoyao San increased cell viability and proliferation, reduced apoptosis and nitrite accumulation, and decreased TNF-α, IL-1β, and IL-6 concentrations. Molecular docking predicted favourable interactions between selected polyphenols and NLRP3, while immunoblotting showed lower NLRP3, caspase-1, and ASC abundance after treatment. The low concentration frequently produced equal or greater effects than the high concentration. These findings connect extraction optimisation with epithelial protection and support chemical standardisation, direct target-engagement studies.

papers.title: Effect of YiFei SanJie Formula on persistent pure ground-glass nodules: a multicenter prospective cohort study.
papers.authors: Li J, Zhou M, Han W, Jiao L, Liu Y, Guo W et al.
papers.abstract: Persistent pure ground-glass nodules (pGGNs) are one of the main imaging manifestations of early-stage lung cancer. However, there is a lack of effective treatment methods except surgical resection. To assess the effectiveness of YiFei SanJie Formula (YFSJF) on pGGNs, we conducted a multicenter prospective cohort study. This study was conducted in four centers in China. The clinical efficacy difference between the YFSJF group and non-YFSJF treatment was compared during the 2-year follow-up. The primary outcome was growth rate. The secondary outcomes included regression rate, volume of pGGN, maximum diameter of pGGN in axial plane, and mean CT attenuation of pGGN in axial plane. From January 2021 to December 2022, 63 patients dropped out. Ultimately, 717 patients (91.9%) were included in the final analysis. After 2-year follow-up, pGGN growth was observed in 27 patients (7.2%) in the YFSJF group, compared to 48 patients (14%) in the non-YFSJF (OR, 0.48; 95% CI, 0.29-0.79; P = 0.004). pGGN regression was observed in 27 patients (7.2%) in the YFSJF group, compared to 13 patients (3.8%) in the non-YFSJF group (OR, 2.31; 95% CI, 1.15-4.65; P = 0.019). In the multivariable analysis, the YFSJF group had a significant effect on the volume change of pGGNs compared with the non-YFSJF group (P < 0.001). However, maximum diameter and mean CT attenuation did not significantly differ between the two groups (P > 0.05). During the 2-year follow-up period, YFSJF may have a certain effect on pGGNs, which can delay the growth of pGGNs and improve the regression.

summary.results: 2년 후 YFSJF군은 pGGN 성장률이 더 낮고 퇴행률이 더 높았으며, 용적 변화도 유의하게 달랐고 최대 직경과 평균 CT 감쇠는 차이가 없었다.
